The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of hydroxylapatite (Ca5(PO4)3OH, COD 1011242) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (Ca = 20, O = 8, P = 15). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (0 0 2)
B. (0 3 0)
C. (0 0 3)
D. (0 2 0)

附件：EN-COD1011242-EXT-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
